blocks.orig: Everybody had heard of of Scarface the lion. The scar around his eye made him an icon, but now the king of the savannah has died, at the age of 14.
blocks.html: Scarface the lion was known to just about everyone. The scar across his eye turned him into an icon, but the king of the savannah has now passed away at 14 years old.

blocks.orig: We have sad news from the animal kingdom. Scarface, the world-famous lion, has left us. In 2012, the then 4-year-old lion was struck with a spear by a Maasai warrior, when encroaching on his territory. The injury left a scar over his right eye. Since then, the big cat has been nicknamed Scar, or Scarface. His name has made him the most famous lion in the world (shoutout to The Lion King’s Scar). For years, he was the head of his pack in the Maasai Mara game reserve in Kenya. His rule prevailed until 1pm on June 11th 2021, when he took his last breath.
blocks.html: Sad news reaches us from the animal kingdom: Scarface, the lion famous around the globe, is no longer with us. Back in 2012, when he was 4 years old, a Maasai warrior struck him with a spear after he strayed onto the warrior's land. That wound left him with a scar above his right eye. From then on the big cat went by the nickname Scar, or Scarface, and that name turned him into the best-known lion on earth (a nod to The Lion King’s Scar). He led his pride in Kenya's Maasai Mara game reserve for many years. That reign lasted until 1pm on June 11th 2021, the moment he breathed his last.

blocks.orig: According to conservationists, he died a natural death. He had already become leaner and increasingly sickly over the last few years. Scar is to be considered lucky, as lions usually don’t live longer than 8 to 15 years in the wilderness.
blocks.html: Conservationists report that he died of natural causes. Over the past few years he had grown thinner and more and more frail. In a sense Scar was fortunate: in the wild, lions rarely live beyond 8 to 15 years.

blocks.orig: The Mara Predator Conservation Organization affirms that Scar had a peaceful death.
blocks.html: The Mara Predator Conservation Organization confirms that Scar passed away peacefully.

blocks.orig: ”He died in peace without the distraction of vehicles or hyenas. We were the only ones in the field by his side, trying to support him…”
blocks.html: ”He died in peace without the distraction of vehicles or hyenas. We were the only ones in the field by his side, trying to support him…”

blocks.orig: Kenya and the whole world mourn him today. He was incredibly admired and was a symbolic icon. Scarface even starred in movies (well, documentaries). Many know him from the BBC documentary “Big Cat Diary”. He even has his own Facebook page. What kind of lion can say the same?
blocks.html: Today Kenya, and indeed the whole world, is in mourning. He was enormously admired and had become a true symbol. Scarface even appeared on screen (in documentaries, that is). Plenty of people will recognise him from the BBC series “Big Cat Diary”, and he even had a Facebook page of his own. Not many lions can claim that.

blocks.orig: Even if he is no longer among us, the memories of him remain in our hearts forever.
blocks.html: He may have left us, but our memories of him will stay with us for good.
